title: Application-level lint rules
summary: Lint rules for whole-program mistakes: disabled TLS verification, UI calls in console or service programs, DUnitX tests without an assertion, weak ciphers, assembler without a Win64 variant, WriteLn in a GUI program, and a contract-unit policy rule
intro: Read this to see what each application-level rule reports, which ship ON or OFF, and how the checks avoid the common false positives.
